verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring runs is a fair question for an API client, but the evidence shows no built-in scheduler, cron, or monitor feature in Insomnia. The pack covers only on-demand Collection Runner runs and the Inso CLI running inside a CI environment; recurrence there would come from the external CI system (a host-platform workaround), which earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
